definition.def: If something confirms what you believe, suspect, or fear, it shows that it is definitely true.
examples: X-rays have confirmed that he has not broken any bones. [VERB that]
These new statistics confirm our worst fears about the depth of the recession. [VERB noun]
This confirms what I suspected all along. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you confirm something that has been stated or suggested, you say that it is true because you know about it.
examples: The spokesman confirmed that the area was now in rebel hands. [VERB that]
He confirmed what had long been feared. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you confirm an arrangement or appointment, you say that it is definite, usually in a letter or email or on the phone.
examples: You make the reservation, and I'll confirm it in writing. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If someone is confirmed, they are formally accepted as a member of a Christian church during a ceremony in which they say they believe what the church teaches.
examples: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: If something confirms you in your decision, belief, or opinion, it makes you think that you are definitely right.
examples: It has confirmed me in my decision not to become a nurse. [VERB noun + in]

definition.def: If someone confirms their position, role, or power, they do something to make their power, position, or role stronger or more definite.
examples: Williams has confirmed his position as the world's number one snooker player. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If something confirms you as something, it shows that you definitely deserve a name, role, or position.
examples: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors. [VERB noun + as]

examples.sentence: Mondrian's works are deceptively simple, but eye-tracking studies confirm that they are meticulously composed, and that simply rotating a piece radically changes the way we view it.
Well, we'll look forward to receiving your application form, and we'll contact you to confirm the interview.
Uh. Right, I can confirm that that's the 21st of May, not the 20th as we first stated.
A host of studies confirm this, covering a wide range of business settings, branch banks, retail stores, real estate agencies, factories, call centers, to name but a few.
You will be asked to confirm that you really want to submit your application.
Inform the employer that you wish to resign and confirm the agreed final date at work.
J&G commits to working closely with you to confirm your assignment expectations, while helping you to ensure that these are achievable.
